title.en: What Is an LLM Actually Trained to Do?

dek.zh: 从 token-level cross-entropy、teacher forcing 到 exposure mismatch：一个局部训练目标如何产生通用能力，又为何不能直接保证 Agent 长轨迹成功。
dek.en: From token-level cross-entropy and teacher forcing to exposure mismatch: how a local training objective produces broad capabilities yet cannot directly guarantee success over a long agent trajectory.

html.zh:
预训练 decoder-only LLM 的核心监督信号通常非常朴素：给定真实文本前缀，提升下一个真实 token 的概率。训练数据不需要为每段文字附上“事实”“推理”“工具使用”标签；文档被 tokenization 后，每个位置都能提供一个预测目标。模型在海量上下文上反复压低 token-level negative log-likelihood，于是参数逐渐编码语法、事实关联、代码模式和可用于推理的中间结构。

但这个目标没有直接说“完成用户任务”“调用正确工具”或“在 20 步后仍然成功”。它优化的是训练分布上的局部条件概率。Agent 运行时则让模型读取 system prompt、工具 schema、自身早先生成的 token 和带噪声的环境 observation，并要求一串局部选择共同形成有效轨迹。两者之间存在目标差距与分布差距。

核心判断：cross-entropy 不是能力清单，也不是端到端任务奖励。它是一个密集、可微、逐 token 的学习信号；能力来自预测所需结构与模型/数据规模的结合，可靠性边界来自局部似然与真实运行目标并不等价。
html.en:
The central pretraining signal for a decoder-only LLM is usually strikingly simple: given a real text prefix, increase the probability of the next real token. A document does not need a separate “fact,” “reasoning,” or “tool use” label. Once tokenized, every position supplies a target. By repeatedly reducing token-level negative log-likelihood across enormous numbers of contexts, the parameters come to encode syntax, factual associations, programming patterns, and intermediate structures that can support reasoning.

The objective, however, never directly says “complete the user’s task,” “choose the correct tool,” or “remain successful after twenty steps.” It optimizes local conditional probabilities on a training distribution. At agent runtime, the model instead reads system instructions, tool schemas, its own earlier tokens, and noisy environmental observations, then must compose many local decisions into a valid trajectory. That creates both an objective gap and a distribution gap.

Core judgment: cross-entropy is neither a capability checklist nor an end-to-end task reward. It is a dense, differentiable, token-level learning signal. Capabilities emerge from the structures useful for prediction combined with model and data scale; reliability remains bounded because local likelihood is not equivalent to the real operational objective.

title.zh: 连接 token loop 与 Agent loop
title.en: Connect the token loop to the agent loop

html.zh:
在 LLM 内核系列中，我们已经看到推理阶段：Transformer 把 prefix 映射成 logits，sampling 选出一个 token，再把它追加到 prefix。训练阶段使用同一类前向计算，但已知整段目标文本。假设序列是 [BOS, 用户, 请求, assistant, tool_call, ...]，模型可以一次并行算出每个位置的 next-token distribution，并分别与真实的后一个 token 比较。

这叫 teacher forcing：预测位置 t 时，输入 prefix 来自数据中的真实 token x<t，而不是模型自己在位置 t−1 采样的结果。它让所有位置可并行训练，并避免早期随机模型生成的垃圾 prefix 淹没学习信号。一次长度为 2,048 的序列可贡献约 2,047 个监督位置，而不是只给一个“整段好/坏”分数。

Agent 推理却必须闭环。第一个参数 token 错了，第二个 token 看到的已经不是训练样本里的理想 prefix；错误 tool call 又会产生训练数据中少见的异常 observation。runtime 把这些结果追加回上下文，后续 token 在一个由模型与环境共同制造的新分布上生成。这就是 exposure mismatch 的工程形态。
html.en:
In the LLM Internals series, we followed inference: a Transformer maps a prefix to logits, sampling selects a token, and that token is appended to the prefix. Training uses the same kind of forward computation, but the complete target text is already available. For a sequence such as [BOS, user, request, assistant, tool_call, ...], the model can compute a next-token distribution at every position in parallel and compare each distribution with the real following token.

This is teacher forcing: when predicting position t, the input prefix comes from the ground-truth data tokens x<t, not from what the model sampled at position t−1. It enables parallel training over positions and prevents garbage prefixes from an initially random model from overwhelming the learning signal. A 2,048-token sequence can contribute roughly 2,047 supervised positions instead of one coarse score for whether the whole sequence was good.

Agent inference must close the loop. If the first argument token is wrong, the second token already sees a prefix different from the ideal example. A bad tool call can produce an unusual error observation. The runtime appends these results, so later tokens are generated from a distribution jointly created by the model and environment. This is the engineering form of exposure mismatch.

html.zh:
1. 构造输入与标签

一批文档先被 tokenizer 变成 token ids，加入边界 token，再切成固定或可变长度序列。训练代码通常把序列向右错一位作为 labels：输入 x₁...xₙ₋₁ 预测 x₂...xₙ。padding、跨文档边界和不希望计入损失的区域用 mask 排除。instruction tuning 还可能只对 assistant completion 计算 loss；那是监督范围选择，不改变 next-token cross-entropy 的基本形式。

2. 一次并行前向

causal mask 使位置 t 只能读取 x≤t，但所有位置的 hidden states 可以并行计算。unembedding 为每个位置产生 vocabulary logits。softmax 把 logits 归一化为条件分布 pθ(xₜ|x<t)。训练无需在每个位置真的 sample；它直接读取真实目标 token 的概率。

3. 汇总 loss 并反向传播

对未 mask 的位置求 negative log-probability，再对 batch 求平均。automatic differentiation 沿 unembedding、Transformer blocks、embedding 一直计算参数梯度。optimizer（例如 AdamW）根据梯度与历史动量更新参数。注意：一条样本不把一个“事实”写入一个固定神经元；它对大量参数施加微小、上下文相关的更新，并与其他样本的梯度叠加或冲突。

tokens = tokenizer(documents)
inputs = tokens[:, :-1]
labels = tokens[:, 1:]
logits = model(inputs, causal_mask=True)
loss = cross_entropy(logits, labels, loss_mask)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()

4. 重复、验证与 checkpoint

训练在许多 batches 上重复，周期性在 held-out validation data 上计算 loss。validation loss 估计模型对相似但未参与更新的数据的预测质量；它不是事实正确率、Agent 成功率或安全性分数。checkpoint 保存权重和 optimizer state，使训练可恢复或比较。最终 base model 仍通常需要 SFT 和 preference/alignment 阶段，才能更稳定地把“继续文本”塑造成“遵循请求”。

为什么这种目标能学出复杂能力？因为在多种文本中准确预测下一个 token，常常需要追踪实体、句法、代码状态、世界关联与长距离依赖。目标不显式命名这些结构，却奖励能降低预测误差的内部表示。这个解释支持“能力可由预测学习”，但不证明模型形成了人类相同的概念，也不保证它在 distribution shift 下继续可靠。
html.en:
1. Construct inputs and labels

Documents are converted to token IDs, boundary tokens are inserted, and the stream is packed into fixed- or variable-length sequences. Training code commonly shifts a sequence by one position: input x₁...xₙ₋₁ predicts labels x₂...xₙ. A loss mask excludes padding, selected document boundaries, or regions that should not contribute supervision. Instruction tuning may compute loss only over assistant completions; that changes which positions are supervised, not the underlying next-token cross-entropy.

2. Run one parallel forward pass

The causal mask prevents position t from reading beyond x≤t, while hidden states for all positions can still be computed in parallel. The unembedding produces vocabulary logits at every position. Softmax normalizes them into conditional distributions pθ(xₜ|x<t). Training does not need to sample at each position. It directly reads the probability assigned to the ground-truth target token.

3. Aggregate loss and backpropagate

Negative log-probabilities are averaged over unmasked positions and the batch. Automatic differentiation propagates gradients through the unembedding, Transformer blocks, and embeddings. An optimizer such as AdamW updates parameters using the current gradient and running moment estimates. One example does not write one fact into one designated neuron. It applies small, context-dependent pressure across many parameters, interacting—constructively or destructively—with gradients from other examples.

tokens = tokenizer(documents)
inputs = tokens[:, :-1]
labels = tokens[:, 1:]
logits = model(inputs, causal_mask=True)
loss = cross_entropy(logits, labels, loss_mask)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()

4. Repeat, validate, and checkpoint

Training repeats over many batches and periodically computes loss on held-out validation data. Validation loss estimates predictive quality on similar data not used for parameter updates; it is not factual accuracy, agent task success, or a safety score. Checkpoints preserve model weights and optimizer state for recovery and comparison. A resulting base model typically still needs supervised instruction tuning and preference or alignment stages to make “continue the text” behave more consistently like “follow the request.”

Why can this objective teach complex capabilities? Across varied text, predicting the next token often requires tracking entities, syntax, program state, world associations, and long-range dependencies. The objective never names those structures; it rewards any internal representation that reduces prediction error. This supports the claim that useful capabilities can be learned through prediction. It does not prove that the model forms human-identical concepts, nor that the learned representations remain reliable under distribution shift.

title.zh: 必要数学：似然、交叉熵与误差复合
title.en: Essential math: likelihood, cross-entropy, and compounded error

html.zh:
序列概率的因式分解

pθ(x₁,...,xT) = ∏t=1T pθ(xt | x<t)

xₜ 是第 t 个 token，x<t 是此前的真实 prefix，θ 是全部模型参数。chain rule 把整段序列的概率拆成每个位置的条件概率；这不是模型独有假设，而是联合概率的恒等分解。causal Transformer 为每一项提供参数化估计。

negative log-likelihood / cross-entropy

L(θ) = − (1/N) Σi=1N log pθ(yi | ci)

N 是未 mask 的训练位置数，cᵢ 是真实 prefix，yᵢ 是真实 next token。若模型给目标 token 概率 0.8，损失约 0.223；给 0.01，损失约 4.605。log 把序列概率的乘积变成和，并强烈惩罚对真实 token 极度自信地判错。对 one-hot 目标，这就是 categorical cross-entropy。最小化它等价于在数据上最大化似然。

Perplexity 常定义为 exp(L)，可直觉化为平均不确定性的有效分支数，但只在相同 tokenizer、数据和 loss mask 下可公平比较。perplexity 从 10 降到 8，不意味着 Agent 成功率按 20% 提升；少数关键 action token 的错误可能决定整个轨迹。

局部误差如何变成长轨迹风险

P(all K critical choices correct) ≈ ∏k=1K (1 − εk)

εₖ 是第 k 个关键决策在其实际 rollout prefix 下出错的概率。若粗略假设 20 个关键选择独立且每个 98% 正确，全部正确约为 0.98²⁰≈0.668。真实错误并不独立：早期错误会改变后续 prefix，可能放大或偶尔被 observation 修复。因此公式不是精确预测，而是说明为什么很低的局部 error rate 也不能直接推出高 long-horizon success。

训练 loss 对所有未 mask token 平均，常见语法 token 占据大量权重；Agent eval 却可能把一个罕见工具名、单位或授权选择视为 0/1 成败。工程上需要给关键决策单独的 behavioral eval，而不是用总体 loss 或 perplexity 替代。
html.en:
Factorizing sequence probability

pθ(x₁,...,xT) = ∏t=1T pθ(xt | x<t)

xₜ is token t, x<t is the preceding ground-truth prefix, and θ denotes all model parameters. The probability chain rule decomposes a sequence probability into conditional probabilities at each position. This is an identity of joint probability, not a special assumption invented for language models. A causal Transformer supplies a parameterized estimate of every factor.

Negative log-likelihood and cross-entropy

L(θ) = − (1/N) Σi=1N log pθ(yi | ci)

N is the number of unmasked training positions, cᵢ is a ground-truth prefix, and yᵢ is its real next token. Assigning the target probability 0.8 produces loss about 0.223; assigning 0.01 produces about 4.605. The logarithm converts the product over sequence probabilities into a sum and strongly penalizes confidently assigning tiny probability to an observed token. With a one-hot categorical target, this is categorical cross-entropy. Minimizing it is equivalent to maximum-likelihood estimation on the dataset.

Perplexity is commonly exp(L). It can be viewed loosely as an effective branching factor for average uncertainty, but comparisons are meaningful only with the same tokenizer, evaluation data, and loss mask. A perplexity decrease from 10 to 8 does not imply a 20 percent increase in agent success. A few critical action-token errors can determine the whole trajectory.

How local error becomes trajectory risk

P(all K critical choices correct) ≈ ∏k=1K (1 − εk)

εₖ is the error probability of critical decision k under the prefix actually encountered during rollout. Under the deliberately crude assumption that twenty critical choices are independent and each is 98 percent accurate, all are correct only about 0.98²⁰ ≈ 0.668 of the time. Real errors are not independent: an early mistake changes later prefixes and may amplify subsequent errors, while a useful environment observation can sometimes repair them. The equation is not a calibrated forecast; it explains why a low local error rate does not imply high long-horizon success.

Training loss averages across all unmasked tokens, giving frequent grammatical tokens considerable weight. An agent evaluation may treat one rare tool name, unit, or authorization decision as binary success or failure. Critical decisions therefore need dedicated behavioral evaluations rather than using aggregate loss or perplexity as a substitute.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
1. 把模型输出当提议，不当训练目标承诺

base model 的训练目标没有“工具执行成功”这一项。即使 post-training 加入工具样本，token likelihood 也不能验证库存、权限、实时 schema 或副作用。runtime 仍需结构校验、policy gate、幂等键和 environment feedback。

2. 评估实际 rollout distribution

只用理想 transcript 做离线 next-token accuracy，会隐藏模型面对自身错误时的行为。Agent eval 应包含 malformed tool result、超时、部分成功、重复 observation、长轨迹和恢复点，并让模型闭环运行。分别报告 first-attempt、recovery、最终成功和副作用安全性，才能看见 error compounding 与 self-correction。

3. observation 可以把轨迹拉回训练支持区

明确、结构化的工具错误比空字符串或长 stack trace 更可能提供模型熟悉的修复模式。返回错误类别、失败字段、允许值和可重试性，同时保留 provenance；不要让模型猜环境状态。verifier 的价值不仅是判错，也是为下一轮构造更有支持度的 prefix。

4. Demonstration 改变条件，不改参数

few-shot 示例放入 prompt 后，模型在新的 prefix 条件下预测；它没有在请求期间执行 optimizer step。示例能把局部分布引向目标格式，却不能保证覆盖异常路径。把 in-context learning 称为“现场训练”容易让团队误以为它会持久更新或自动获得权限。

5. 数据与 loss mask 决定被奖励的行为

若 instruction tuning 只对 assistant token 计算 loss，模型被直接训练去复现 assistant completion，而 system/user tokens 只是条件。如果工具调用样本大多是成功 happy path，错误恢复的 likelihood 学习信号就不足。Agent 团队需要知道训练数据边界；不知道时，用 adversarial rollout 测试，而不要从模型规模推断。
html.en:
1. Treat model output as a proposal, not a promise from the objective

A base model’s training objective contains no term for “the tool execution succeeded.” Even when post-training includes tool examples, token likelihood cannot verify inventory, authorization, a live schema, or a side effect. The runtime still needs structural validation, policy gates, idempotency keys, and environmental feedback.

2. Evaluate the rollout distribution you actually create

Offline next-token accuracy on ideal transcripts hides how the model behaves after its own errors. Agent evaluations should include malformed tool results, timeouts, partial success, repeated observations, long trajectories, and recovery checkpoints while allowing the loop to run closed. Report first-attempt accuracy, recovery rate, final success, and side-effect safety separately to expose both compounding and self-correction.

3. Observations can pull a trajectory back toward supported context

A concise, structured tool error is more likely than an empty string or a giant stack trace to match repair patterns the model can use. Return an error class, failed field, allowed values, and retryability, while preserving provenance. Do not make the model infer environmental state. A verifier is valuable not only because it rejects an error, but because it constructs a better-supported prefix for the next prediction.

4. Demonstrations change conditioning, not parameters

When few-shot examples are placed in a prompt, the model predicts under a new prefix; it does not execute an optimizer step during the request. Examples can move the local distribution toward a target format without guaranteeing coverage of exceptional paths. Calling in-context learning “training on the fly” can mislead a team into expecting persistent updates or newly acquired permissions.

5. Data and loss masks determine which behavior is rewarded

If instruction tuning computes loss only on assistant tokens, the model is directly trained to reproduce assistant completions while system and user tokens serve as conditions. If tool-use examples mostly show happy paths, error recovery receives insufficient likelihood training. Agent teams need to understand training-data boundaries where possible; when they do not, adversarial rollout testing is safer than inferring behavior from model size.

html.zh:
Teacher forcing 的效率 vs rollout mismatch：真实 prefix 让训练稳定并行，却不会直接训练“错误发生后怎样继续”。scheduled sampling 曾提出逐步混入模型生成 token，但其离散采样、训练不一致和统计目标问题使它不是通用 LLM 解法。现代系统更多依赖大规模多样数据、post-training、合成 rollout 与闭环 eval 的组合。

平均 loss vs 稀有关键行为：降低常见 token 的误差能显著改善总体 loss，却可能几乎不改变稀有 API 名或安全拒绝。可通过数据重采样、样本权重、专门 SFT 或 preference objective 强调它们，但会带来过拟合、能力迁移与行为冲突风险。

Maximum likelihood vs 唯一正确答案：自然语言下一步常有多个合理 token，而训练样本只展示其中一个。one-hot cross-entropy 会提升观察到的 token，但也可给同义选择保留概率。若数据本身冲突或错误，目标会如实学习其混合分布；规模不能自动把真相从重复偏差中分离。

低 validation loss vs distribution shift：held-out split 若与训练数据同源，只证明同分布泛化。生产 Agent 的专有 schema、最新事实、长错误轨迹可能远离该分布。必须用时间切分、领域外集和真实工具 sandbox 补充。

“误差会相乘”不等于必然崩溃：模型可以自我修复，environment 也能纠正；同一个错误可能不影响任务。因此不要用独立误差乘积预测 SLA。它是风险直觉，真正的数值来自闭环 trace eval。
html.en:
Teacher-forcing efficiency versus rollout mismatch: ground-truth prefixes make training stable and parallel, but do not directly teach what to do after an error. Scheduled sampling proposed gradually mixing model-generated tokens into training. Discrete sampling, objective inconsistency, and statistical issues prevent it from being a universal LLM solution. Modern systems more often combine broad data, post-training, synthetic rollouts, and closed-loop evaluation.

Average loss versus rare critical behavior: improving common-token predictions can substantially reduce total loss while barely moving a rare API name or safety refusal. Data resampling, example weighting, targeted supervised tuning, or preference objectives can emphasize those cases, but introduce risks of overfitting, capability trade-offs, and behavioral conflicts.

Maximum likelihood versus one uniquely correct answer: natural language frequently permits several reasonable next tokens while a training example shows one. One-hot cross-entropy raises the observed token’s probability but can retain probability on synonymous alternatives. When data is contradictory or wrong, the objective learns that mixed distribution. Scale does not automatically separate truth from repeated bias.

Low validation loss versus distribution shift: a held-out split drawn from the same source mostly demonstrates in-distribution generalization. A production agent’s proprietary schemas, recent facts, and long failure trajectories can lie far outside that distribution. Time-based splits, domain-shifted sets, and real tool sandboxes are necessary complements.

“Errors multiply” does not mean inevitable collapse: models can self-correct, environments can provide corrective evidence, and some errors are irrelevant to task completion. Do not convert the independent-error product into an SLA forecast. It is a risk intuition; calibrated numbers must come from closed-loop trace evaluation.

html.zh:
• 预训练用真实 prefix 上的 next-token cross-entropy 提供密集监督；它优化局部似然，不直接优化 Agent 成功。
  • teacher forcing 使序列位置可并行训练，却造成训练 prefix 与闭环 rollout prefix 的 exposure mismatch。
  • perplexity 只在 tokenizer、数据和 mask 一致时可比，也不能替代关键 tool decision 与长轨迹成功率。
  • 早期错误会改变后续输入分布；结构化 observation、verifier 和 recovery policy 能把轨迹拉回可处理区域。
  • few-shot prompt 改变模型条件而非参数；训练数据覆盖、loss mask 与 post-training 决定哪些行为真正获得学习信号。
html.en:
• Pretraining supplies dense supervision through next-token cross-entropy on ground-truth prefixes. It optimizes local likelihood, not agent success directly.
  • Teacher forcing enables parallel training across sequence positions while creating exposure mismatch between training prefixes and closed-loop rollout prefixes.
  • Perplexity is comparable only under a consistent tokenizer, dataset, and mask, and cannot replace evaluation of critical tool decisions or long-horizon success.
  • Early mistakes change later input distributions. Structured observations, verifiers, and recovery policies can pull a trajectory back into a supported region.
  • Few-shot prompts change conditioning rather than parameters. Training coverage, loss masks, and post-training determine which behaviors receive direct learning signal.

html.zh:
• Bengio et al., A Neural Probabilistic Language Model — 早期神经语言模型以分布式词表示估计条件概率，为 maximum-likelihood 神经语言建模提供基础。
  • Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need — Transformer 与 causal/auto-regressive decoding 的架构基础；原模型是 encoder-decoder。
  • Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners — GPT-3 的 autoregressive pretraining objective、训练规模与 in-context evaluation。论文报告不代表所有后续模型。
  • Bengio et al., Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks — 明确讨论训练时真实 token 与推理时模型 token 的差异，并提出 scheduled sampling；方法针对当时的 sequence models，不是现代 LLM 的默认处方。
  • Huszár, How (not) to Train your Generative Model — 对 scheduled sampling 的一致性提出理论批评，提醒 exposure mismatch 没有简单的混入采样解法。
  • Ouyang et al., Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback — 展示在 next-token pretraining 之后加入 SFT 与 RLHF 的典型 pipeline；其具体收益是作者在 InstructGPT 设置中的实验结果。

本文把 exposure mismatch 映射到 tool loop、结构化错误、verifier 与 closed-loop eval，是基于训练机制的编辑性工程推论；这些建议不是上述论文共同验证的统一 Agent 架构。
html.en:
• Bengio et al., A Neural Probabilistic Language Model — an early neural language model that estimates conditional probabilities with distributed word representations, establishing foundations for maximum-likelihood neural language modeling.
  • Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need — the architectural basis for Transformers and autoregressive decoding; the original model is encoder-decoder.
  • Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners — documents GPT-3’s autoregressive pretraining objective, training scale, and in-context evaluation. Reported findings do not automatically generalize to every later model.
  • Bengio et al., Scheduled Sampling for Sequence Prediction with Recurrent Neural Networks — explicitly discusses the difference between ground-truth tokens during training and model tokens during inference, then proposes scheduled sampling. It addresses sequence models of that period rather than serving as a default prescription for modern LLMs.
  • Huszár, How (not) to Train your Generative Model — provides a theoretical critique of scheduled sampling’s consistency, illustrating that exposure mismatch has no trivial mix-in-sampling solution.
  • Ouyang et al., Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback — shows a representative pipeline adding supervised fine-tuning and RLHF after next-token pretraining. Its gains are author-reported results in the InstructGPT setting.

Mapping exposure mismatch onto tool loops, structured errors, verifiers, and closed-loop evaluation is editorial engineering analysis based on the training mechanism. These recommendations are not a single agent architecture jointly validated by the cited papers.

title.en: What is established and where we continue

html.zh:
今天已建立：next-token pretraining 在真实 prefix 上用 cross-entropy / maximum likelihood 学习；teacher forcing 提供并行、密集的监督，却不直接覆盖模型自身输出造成的 rollout 分布；平均 token loss 与 Agent 的关键动作、恢复能力和最终成功不是同一指标。

尚未讲完：我们说了梯度会更新参数，但还没有打开“怎样更新得动”：learning rate、batch、AdamW、gradient clipping、数据混合与 compute budget 如何共同决定模型学到什么；scaling law 又能预测什么、不能预测什么。

下一篇起点：训练目标与推理控制 2/4 将进入优化与 scaling：从一次 gradient step 到大规模训练 recipe，并把 data quality、memorization、under/over-training 与 Agent 能力边界连接起来。
html.en:
Established today: next-token pretraining learns by cross-entropy and maximum likelihood on ground-truth prefixes. Teacher forcing provides parallel, dense supervision but does not directly cover the rollout distribution created by the model’s own output. Average token loss is not the same metric as an agent’s critical actions, recovery behavior, or final success.

Still unresolved: we said gradients update parameters but have not opened the machinery that makes useful updates possible. Learning rates, batches, AdamW, gradient clipping, data mixtures, and compute budgets jointly determine what is learned; scaling laws predict some outcomes and leave others untouched.

Next starting point: Training Objectives & Inference Control 2/4 will examine optimization and scaling—from one gradient step to a large training recipe—and connect data quality, memorization, under- or over-training, and the boundaries of agent capability.

zh: next-token cross-entropy 在真实 prefix 上最大化训练数据似然
teacher forcing 提供逐位置并行监督，但训练与闭环 rollout 的 prefix 分布不同
平均 loss/perplexity 不能替代关键 Agent 决策和长轨迹成功率
结构化 observation 与 verifier 可以帮助错误轨迹恢复
en: Next-token cross-entropy maximizes training-data likelihood on ground-truth prefixes
Teacher forcing provides parallel per-position supervision while training and closed-loop rollout prefixes follow different distributions
Average loss or perplexity cannot replace evaluation of critical agent decisions and long-horizon success
Structured observations and verifiers can help an erroneous trajectory recover

next.en: Move into optimization and scaling: how learning rates, batches, AdamW, data mixtures, and compute budgets turn local gradients into model capability, and where scaling-law predictions stop.
